correctness.rationale: The H-description follows directly from the split-graph stable-set vertices. Section slicing yields Beta(p,q+1) and independent cube/simplex conditional laws. Each covariance is block permutation-invariant, with the two contrast eigenvalues lying strictly between the eigenvalues of its two-by-two constant-block matrix. Determinants are strictly positive, and trace/determinant identities give exact formulas. The comparison reduces to an explicit integer cubic; its sign, three real roots, and the asymptotic thresholds follow by exact inequalities and convergence. Enumerated rational covariance and independent simplex triangulation checks corroborate the algebra without substituting for infinite proof.
